description: This Java class defines an Android Fragment that displays PDF pages using PdfRenderer, with navigation buttons to move between pages and state management for current page index.

classes.name: PdfRendererBasicFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment that displays PDF pages using PdfRenderer, with navigation controls and state management.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Initializes views, sets click listeners, and restores or shows the first PDF page.

methods.name: onAttach
methods.description: Opens the PDF renderer when fragment attaches to activity.

methods.name: onDetach
methods.description: Closes the PDF renderer when fragment detaches.

methods.name: openRenderer
methods.description: Prepares PdfRenderer by copying PDF from assets if needed and opening file descriptor.

methods.name: closeRenderer
methods.description: Closes PdfRenderer, current page, and file descriptor.

methods.name: showPage
methods.description: Displays specified PDF page as bitmap in ImageView.

methods.name: updateUi
methods.description: Updates navigation buttons and activity title based on current page.

methods.name: getPageCount
methods.description: Returns total number of pages in the PDF.

methods.name: onClick
methods.description: Handles navigation button clicks to change pages.
